components.name: Precision Button
components.description: Primary action button with high-contrast state.
components.css: .ds-btn-precision { background: #fbfbfb; color: #000; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 16px; font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-precision:hover { background: #fff; transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-precision:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Data Card
components.css: .ds-card-precision { background: #0a0a0a; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; width: 200px; } .ds-card-label { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-card-value { color: #fbfbfb; font-family: monospace; font-size: 18px; }

narrative.overview: InvoiceAI is a system built on functional minimalism and technical accuracy. It rejects the 'bubbly' SaaS aesthetic in favor of sharp lines, high-density data views, and monospaced accents that signal its AI-powered precision.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The Llama Violet accent must occupy ≤5% of any given screen.

rules.name: The Monospace Anchor
rules.body: Any value that is extracted by AI or part of a data table MUST use the monospaced font family.

dos: Do use absolute black (#000000) for the main background
Do use Geist Mono for all numerical data
donts: Don't use generic SaaS purple-indigo gradients
